Hi all —

Thanks for the redline, Helen. I reviewed the tracked changes and pulled together a short reply and two proposed times for the legal sync:

Summary (high-level):
- Data residency (Sec. 7): we can accept a region-bound commit for PHI processing if BlueOak is willing to add the standard SCCs and allow for SOC2 evidence review cadence. Proposed wording included in my notes.
- Audit & logs (Sec. 12): we'll offer redacted evidence and a hosted audit summary; on-site audits will require a scoped process and NDA.
- Indemnity (Sec. 15): we can increase the cap for healthcare customers to a 2x multiplier of the standard commercial cap with carveouts for gross negligence.

Proposed legal sync slots (PT):
- Tue 8/17, 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed 8/18, 14:00–14:45 PT
